topic: Garling orchestrated the God Valley Incident hunting competition, designed the entire thing for profit, then took credit when Rocks fell
title: Garling Designed God Valley For Profit
description: Garling found the Davy Family on God Valley, then decided to host the World Nobles' Native Hunting Competition on that exact island. A hundred thousand civilians marked as targets. The competition opening showed every detail of what he was orchestrating—and he got promoted for it instead of punished.
comment: Was Garling actually orchestrating God Valley from the very beginning, or did he stumble into the whole thing by accident?

lines.text: Garling found the Davy Family on God Valley, then turned that discovery into a hunting competition for the World Nobles themselves.
A hundred thousand civilians marked as targets. He picked the island. He designed the opening ceremony.

shot.fallback: grand ceremony announcing a cruel game

lines.text: The Davy Family themselves were announced as Super Rare targets worth the most points of all.

shot.search: Davy Family announced rare targets Garling
shot.fallback: hidden family displayed as prized targets

lines.text: Chapter 1158 shows the World Government knew exactly what was happening, and did nothing to stop it.
Saturn, one of the Five Elders already, watched the opening and personally complimented Garling on the find.

shot.fallback: powerful elder praising a subordinate's plan

lines.text: This wasn't some surprise nobody saw coming. This was a man profiting from an entire island's suffering with official blessing.

shot.fallback: calculated profit hidden in plain sight

lines.text: And when Rocks and Roger's crews showed up, he didn't defend the civilians trapped in that hunt.

shot.fallback: abandonment of the helpless for the powerful

lines.text: He had the Marines pull back and protect the Celestial Dragons instead, letting everyone else fend for themselves...

shot.fallback: system valuing some lives over others

self_check.hook: line 1 states the claim directly (Garling designed for profit), line 3-4 provide proof with chapter number, line 6 drives the argument home
self_check.loop: last line leads back into line 1's setup (his priorities revealed through his choices) without exact repetition
